import re

def parse_nginx_log_line(line: str) -> dict:
    """
    Parse an nginx access log line into a dictionary.

    Expected format (common combined format):
    IP - - [timestamp] "METHOD URL HTTP/VERSION" status bytes "referer" "user-agent"

    Example:
    192.168.1.1 - - [10/Oct/2023:13:55:36 +0000] "GET /index.html HTTP/1.1" 200 1234 "-" "Mozilla/5.0"

    Returns a dict with keys: ip, timestamp, method, url, http_version, status, bytes_sent, referer, user_agent
    """
    pattern = re.compile(
        r'^(?P<ip>\S+) - - '
        r'\[(?P<timestamp>[^\]]+)\] '
        r'"(?P<method>\S+) (?P<url>[^"]+) (?P<http_version>[^"]+)" '
        r'(?P<status>\d+) '
        r'(?P<bytes_sent>\d+) '
        r'"(?P<referer>[^"]*)" '
        r'"(?P<user_agent>[^"]*)"'
    )

    match = pattern.match(line)
    if not match:
        raise ValueError(f"Could not parse nginx log line: {line}")

    return match.groupdict()
